data.name: Raufah
data.gender_notes: Raufah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Raufah is an Islamic name for girls and boys, derived from the Arabic root 'ra-fa-ha', which means 'to be tender, to show mercy, to be compassionate'. The name Raufah carries the meaning “Tender mercy, compassionate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Raufah usually hope their child will grow to embody tender mercy, compassionate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that reflects the compassionate and merciful nature of Allah (SWT).
data.etymology: Raufah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Tender mercy, compassionate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raufah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: رؤفة
in_arabic.meaning: رؤفة تعني الرحمة و العطف و اللطف في المعاملة
in_arabic.long_meaning: رؤفة هي اسم مشتق من الرؤف و هو الرحمة و العطف و اللطف في المعاملة، و يدل على صفة جميلة في الشخصية الإسلامية، و هي من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و حميدة في اللغة العربية و في التقاليد الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: رؤفہ
in_urdu.meaning: رؤفہ کا مطلب ہے رحمت، مہربانی اور معاملات میں خوش اخلاقی
in_urdu.long_meaning: رؤفہ ایک ایسا نام ہے جو Arabic root 'رؤف' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں رحمت، مہربانی اور معاملات میں خوش اخلاقی۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں ایک خوبصورت صفت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے اور اسلامی دنیا میں اس کا اہم کردار ہے

in_hindi.name: रौफ़ा
in_hindi.meaning: रौफ़ा का अर्थ है दया, करुणा और अच्छे बर्ताव
in_hindi.long_meaning: रौफ़ा एक ऐसा नाम है जो अरबी मूल 'रौफ़' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है दया, करुणा और अच्छे बर्ताव। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में एक सुंदर विशेषता को दर्शाता है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका महत्वपूर्ण स्थान है

Naming a child Raufah, instills in them the necessary virtues to be good, caring, and gentle individuals in their communities and families.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islam, being compassionate, merciful, and kind is a fundamental aspect of one's faith. The spiritual significance of the name Raufah is a reminder of the importance of showing compassion and kindness towards everyone, regardless of their faith, as a reflection of Allah's mercy towards us all.
